notes.title: Drifters & Demons
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Just wanted to do a quick announcement of a new game I'm working on together with Armor Games. The game is called [b]Drifters & Demons[/b], and is a top-down shooter / base-builder where you must build and protect a camp of survivors in a demon-infested wasteland. We have a lot of fun features planned for this, so if it looks like something you'd enjoy, please follow the link below.

[b]Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270600/Drifters__Demons/]Drifters & Demons on Steam[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092285/f253fef04d8fca560b6c0cdc05b6d19d4bceaac3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Void Tyrant is available now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey there, Space Warriors![/h1]

Good news: [b]Void Tyrant is officially available now on Steam![/b] We're so excited for you all to try our game on PC for the first time.

[previewyoutube=osRWrJSBHsQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're someone who's played the original on mobile, you'll be happy to find a bunch of exciting quality-of-life features exclusive to this version of the game, including:
[list]
[*] controller support
[*] custom keybinding
[*] cloud saves
[*] and more!
[/list]
Thank you all so much for your support! We couldn't have gotten here without you.

[b]Grab it here now:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332090/Void_Tyrant/

notes.title: Void Tyrant Demo is Playable Now
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that ahead of the Steam Next Fest on June 16th we've launched the demo for Void Tyrant.

We're even featured in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Fest Strategy trailer! [/url]

[previewyoutube=egSAD6IbqtU;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy a taste of the blackjack-roguelite action, and be sure to wishlist the game if you haven't had a chance to do so already.
